item.text: {"verdict":"accurate","confidence":0.99,"rationale":"参考摘录逐字载有该引文，并由第一人称叙述明确表明这是《奥德赛》中奥德修斯对独眼巨人隐瞒身份时所说的话，且该情节确属第9卷。","cited_evidence":["‘Cyclops, you ask my name and I will tell it you; give me, therefore, the present you promised me; my name is Noman; this is what my father and mother and my friends have always called me.’","“then, when I saw that the wine had got into his head, I said to him”","“say it was the valiant warrior Ulysses, son of Laertes, who lives in Ithaca.”"]}
